description: Demolition and redevelopment to provide detached dwellinghouse with habitable roof space; attached double garage; first floor rear balcony; four rear dormers; rooflights in roof slopes; solar panels; hard and soft landscaping; bin and cycle stores; EV charging points; air source heat pumps to side
decision_conditions: All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.

The roof area of the single storey side extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

None of the existing trees on the site shall be lopped, topped, felled or uprooted without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping which is approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work).
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The window(s) in the&nbsp;first
floor southeast and southwest elevation(s) serving bathrooms, en-suites and
dressing rooms&nbsp;of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until a scale, colour plan of biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number, specification, and location of enhancements such as hedgehog highways, herptile hibernacula/refugia, bat boxes, bee bricks, and bird boxes, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the approved details.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, prior to the commencement of works (except for demolition works) hereby permitted shall not proceed until details and full specification of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of:</p><p><br></p><p>(a) the building(s)/extension</p><p>(b) the ground surfacing</p><p><br></p><p>have been submitted to, (or made available to view on the site), and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the commencement of works hereby approved other than demolition works, full details of the proposed lift and overrun shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include full specifications and section drawings that show any overrun. The development shall be installed in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted details of shelters, racks, dimensions and location of cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, full details of bin stores shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The bin store shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter. The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the approved drawing.&nbsp;</p>

<p>No development shall commence until a Self-Build Biodiversity Net Gain Exemption Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the [Local Planning Authority]. The Statement shall demonstrate that the development qualifies for the self-build and custom housebuilding exemption from the biodiversity gain planning condition and shall include:</p><p><br></p><p>(a) a statement confirming that the development will be self-build or custom housebuilding within the meaning of section 1(A1) of the Self-build and Custom Housebuilding Act 2015;</p><p>(b) evidence that the dwelling is to be commissioned by the individual who will occupy that dwelling as their home;</p><p>(c) evidence that the individual had input into the design and layout of their dwelling;</p><p>(d) such other information as is reasonably required by the Local Planning Authority to verify that the development meets the criteria for self-build or custom housebuilding.</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Self-Build BNG Exemption Statement.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, AA, B, E and F in Part 1 and Class L of Part 3 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.</p>

<p>The construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby permitted shall not be commenced (other than works of demolition) until the following details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</p><p><br></p><p>a) Flood Risk Assessment</p><p>b) Works for the disposal of surface water and surface water attenuation and storage works, including construction details of a new raised patio with void underneath, how floodwater enters the void, access for maintenance/removing silt,</p><p>c) Works for the disposal of sewage</p><p>d) full details of permeable paving</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>No construction works shall take place including any works of demolition, until a Construction Method Statement and Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The Method Statement shall provide for:</p><p><br></p><p>a) detailed timeline for the phases and implementation of the development</p><p>b) the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;</p><p>c) loading and unloading of plant and materials;</p><p>d) storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development;</p><p>e) measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction; and</p><p>f) scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Method Statement &amp; Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority throughout the construction period.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of works hereby approved, all required tree protection fencing and the installation of no-dig cellular confine system (without finished permeable layer to act as ground protect) as detailed in the Arboricultural Method Statement within the Arboricultural Report (Ref. 2024017 v1.0) and Tree Survey Schedule dated 04/03/2024, shall be in place. The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site. Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition, and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved other than demolition works, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</p><p><br></p><p>a) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space:</p><p>i) for fire appliances to be positioned on</p><p>ii) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point</p><p>b) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures</p><p>c) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread</p><p>d) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users</p><p>e) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</p><p>f) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development. The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until there has been a scheme of hard and soft landscape works for the site submitted to, and approved by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100), schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities.</p><p>Hard landscape works shall include; details of boundary treatments (materials, scale of boundary, location) and details of hard surfacing materials to be used in the landscaping of the site, Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken, A landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works.</p>

<p>During the construction phase, precautionary working methods should be adopted, as set out in Section 6 of the Preliminary Ecological Appraisal (Ref: DKS/1469.1 Preliminary Ecological Appraisal, Arborweald, 2025) to include, but not be limited to:</p><p><br></p><p>•<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Identification of a suitably qualified ecologist to act as an emergency contact for construction workers;</p><p>•<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Fence installation to protect retained habitat during works;</p><p>•<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Completion of a toolbox talk by a suitably qualified ecologist;</p><p>•<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Timing of works between April and September;</p><p>•<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Sensitive dismantling (by hand) of roof and soffit boxes;</p><p>•<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Phased vegetation clearance;</p><p>•<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>No use of artificial lighting during construction;</p><p>•<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Covering of trenches/holes each day upon completion of activities;</p><p>•<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Immediately cease all works if a protected species is suspected to be present within/using the site.</p>

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Consultation Letter (To residents of properties surrounding White Lodge, Nugents Park);Copy of Part I 2021 GLA Carbon Emission Report Spreadsheet; Design &amp; Access Statement; DKS/1469.1 Version 001; DKS/1469.1 Preliminary Ecological Appraisal; Energy and Carbon Statement; Proposed Air Source Heat Pumps – Noise Assessment Report; Planning Fire Safety Statement; Re: Planning application submission White Lodge, Nugents Park, Hatch End HA5 4RA (Cover Letter); Tree Survey Schedule; 370/White Lodge; 085/EX/001; 085/EX/100; 085/EX/101; 085/EX/103; 085/EX/104; 085/EX/120; 085/EX/121; 085/PL/200; 085/PL/201; 085/PL/202; 085/PL/203; 085/PL/204; 085/PL/206; 085/PL/207; 085/PL/208; 085/PL/209; 25084-EPS-001; 25084-EPS-002; 25084SUDs-1-Rev -; 2024017 v1.0; 2024017/ETP001.

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, a Post Installation Noise Impact Assessment for the Air Source Heat Pumps with the details of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, including:</p><p><br></p><p>(a) detailed particulars of the levels of noise to be generated in the building,</p><p>(b) details mitigation measures to be made for the insulation of the Air Source Heat Pump against the transmission of noise and vibration by reason of granting this permission, and of times during which noise producing activities will be carried out.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall not be occupied or used until the works have been completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>
